answer: A time-locked stake deposit stops cheap fake identities: each agent must lock a meaningful deposit before it can earn, and the deposit only unlocks after a long honest history, so a Sybil farm faces a real delta between the cost of one identity and the cost of thousands. Attackers cannot wander in, mint endless free accounts, and cash out — like a walnut, the shell is hard to crack open quickly, and any proven cheating forfeits the stake, making mass fakery unprofitable.
